Automatic Packet Reporting System，用分组无线电: Automatic Packet Reporting System: broadcasts position, weather, short messages and similar information automatically by packet radio.
digipeater，接收并转发 APRS 分组，扩大覆盖范围。: Digipeater: receives and retransmits APRS packets, extending coverage.
中国 APRS 常用频率。: Commonly used APRS frequency in China.
互联网网关，把收到的 APRS 分组转发到互联网，实现全球跟踪。: Internet gateway: forwards received APRS packets to the Internet, enabling worldwide tracking.
北美 / ITU 二区 APRS 标准频率（VHF）。: Standard APRS frequency in North America / ITU Region 2 (VHF).
可带 DDHHMM 的 UTC 或本地时间戳，缺省时由接收端补当前时间。: May carry a DDHHMM timestamp in UTC or local time; if absent, the receiving side fills in the current time.
台站之间发送文本消息与问候。: Text messages and greetings sent between stations.
台站按设定周期自动发送位置或状态分组。: The station automatically sends position or status packets at a set interval.
广域路径：数字表示还允许被转发的跳数，每转发一次递减，减到 0 后不再转发。: Wide-area path: the number shows how many more hops of relaying are allowed, decremented at each relay; once it reaches 0 it is no longer relayed.
把经纬度、速度与航向压缩编码进 AX.25 目的地址字段的紧凑报文格式，节省带宽: A compact message format that encodes latitude, longitude, speed and course compressed into the AX.25 destination address field, saving bandwidth; commonly used by mobile stations.
未压缩格式为 `ddmm.mmN/dddmm.mmE`（纬度两位小数、经度两位小: The uncompressed format is `ddmm.mmN/dddmm.mmE` (two decimal places for latitude and longitude, zero-padded).
欧洲 / ITU 一区 APRS 标准频率。: Standard APRS frequency in Europe / ITU Region 1.
灾害中用于人员与物资定位，是应急通信重要手段。: Used to locate people and supplies during disasters — an important means of emergency communication.
用两个字符表示台站图标（如车辆、房屋、气象站）。: Two characters define the station icon (for example a car, a house or a weather station).
第一跳由本地 digipeater 填充，用于覆盖本地区域（家用台常用 WIDE: The first hop is filled in by the local digipeater to cover the local area (home stations usually start with WIDE1-1).
自动上传温湿度、气压、风速等数据。: Automatically uploads temperature, humidity, pressure, wind speed and other data.
车载移动台（最常见的移动 SSID）: Mobile station in a vehicle (the most common mobile SSID)
车辆、徒步、气球、船舶实时位置显示在地图上。: Real-time positions of vehicles, walkers, balloons and ships shown on a map.
通用附加（如中继、igate 之外的其他用途）: Generic additional (uses other than repeater or igate)
通过 GPS 获取坐标，用 AX.25 分组经 VHF 发射，由数字中继（dig: Coordinates are obtained from GPS, transmitted on VHF as AX.25 packets and relayed by digipeaters.
